Getting protein in the morning is very important. Here is a way to get some high-quality protein as a delicious muffin. What do you think? Are you going to make these?

 

I Turned Bryan Johnson’s Blueprint Protein Into Muffins!

 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2t7g2ozTPEo
comment: Turning a protein powder into something you actually look forward to eating is a pretty practical idea. A lot of people struggle with consistency because shakes get boring fast. I’d be curious how the texture compares to a normal muffin and whether the added ingredients change the protein quality or just make it easier to stick with.
